subject: general
question: Atmospheric temperature does NOT depend on _________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**salinity of oceans.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Atmospheric temperature **is primarily influenced by air temperature, solar radiation, altitude, latitude, and distance from the sea.
 
• While salinity can affect ocean currents and water temperature, it does not directly impact atmospheric temperature.
 
• Variations in salinity can **influence local weather patterns **but do** not have a direct relationship with atmospheric temperature.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Distance from Sea:**

 
 
• Areas closer to the sea tend to have milder temperatures due to the **moderating effect of water,** which heats up and cools down more slowly than land.
 
• Coastal regions often experience less temperature variation compared to inland areas, which can lead to **higher or lower temperatures** depending on their distance from the ocean.
 
 
 
• **Latitude:**
 
 
• Latitude significantly** affects atmospheric temperature**, with equatorial regions generally experiencing warmer temperatures and polar regions being colder.
 
• The angle of sunlight varies with latitude, **influencing the amount of solar energy** received by different parts of the Earth.
 
 
 
• **Altitude:**
 
 
• As altitude increases,** atmospheric temperature typically decreases due to the thinning of the atmosphere **and reduced air pressure.
 
• Higher elevations tend to have cooler temperatures, regardless of latitude or proximity to the sea.
